cards.text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, had carried God's people off into exile, and the house of God in Jerusalem had been set on fire (2 Chronicles 36:19-20). Now Persia's in power, and it's the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia. And friend, the LORD is about to get to work, and He's starting with the KING.

cards.question: The LORD stirs the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia. Why?

answers.text: To fulfill His word spoken through Jeremiah the prophet
To answer the prayers Cyrus himself had prayed
To repay Judah for everything Babylon took

cards.text: So Cyrus sends a proclamation all through his kingdom, and he puts it in WRITING. Friend, once a king puts it in writing, that's not a text you can unsend.

cards.question: Cyrus says the LORD, the God of heaven, has appointed him to build a ___ for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.
Cyrus says his own armies won him all the kingdoms of the earth.
Cyrus says whoever belongs to the LORD's people may go up to Jerusalem. What does he wish for each one who goes?

answers.text: That his God will be with him
That he will find his family's land
That he will stay loyal to Persia

cards.text: Then Cyrus's proclamation turns to the survivors, wherever they live. Friend, moving your whole life back home costs a LOT.

cards.question: Cyrus says the men of each region should help the survivors with silver, gold, goods and livestock.
Cyrus's proclamation mentions a ___ offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.

cards.text: So who packs up? The family heads of Judah and Benjamin, plus the priests and Levites.

cards.question: Everyone who gets ready to go up and rebuild has this in common: God had stirred their spirit.

cards.text: And their neighbors come THROUGH with silver and gold, goods and livestock, and valuables, on top of all the freewill offerings. That's a going-away party where nobody bothered with a card, just GOLD.
Then Cyrus brings out something Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem.

cards.question: What does Cyrus bring out that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem?

answers.text: The articles from the house of the LORD
The crown of Judah's last king

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar had put the articles from the house of the LORD in the ___ of his ___.
Cyrus has Mithredath the treasurer count the articles out to someone. Who?

answers.text: Daniel the chief of the wise men

cards.text: Then the inventory: gold and silver dishes, bowls, utensils and more, 5,400 gold and silver articles in all. Sheshbazzar brings every one of them along when the exiles go up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

Now we meet the people of the province who came up out of captivity in Babylon, headed back to Jerusalem and Judah. Eleven men come up with them, starting with Zerubbabel, governor of Judah (Haggai 1:1), and Jeshua, a priest (Ezra 3:2).

cards.question: The exiles coming up from Babylon return to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own ___.

cards.text: Then comes the count, family by family and town by town, with the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers and temple servants all in it. Some families can't prove they come from Israel, and some priestly families can't find their family records. The whole assembly numbers 42,360, not counting servants and singers, and they bring along 6,720 DONKEYS. Friend, that's not a caravan, that's rush hour on the highway.

cards.question: When the returned exiles reach the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, who gives freewill offerings for it?

answers.text: Some of the heads of the families
Every family in the whole assembly
Only the priests and the Levites

cards.question: Those family heads give their freewill offerings so the house of God can be rebuilt on a brand-new site.
The family heads give to the treasury for the work according to their ___.

cards.text: Into the treasury go 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver and 100 priestly garments. Friend, that's not pocket change, that's the whole POCKET.

The priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers and temple servants, along with some of the people, settle in their own towns, and the rest of the Israelites settle in theirs. But that house of God still isn't rebuilt, friend, and this story's not done yet.
